purpose: Epoch ranges that have validation-loss evidence but no per-epoch diagnostics, each with the reason the producer was absent. build_metrics_catalog.py still fails on any gap that is not declared here; a declaration makes the gap visible, it does not excuse it.

gaps.reason: The RTX 3090 diagnostics pod ended between epoch 78 and 79 on 2026-08-12 and was not replaced before the campaign finished. The L40S kept training, so epochs 79-114 have validation loss, learning rate and structural-invariant evidence but no distribution metrics.
gaps.consequence: The accepted best checkpoint for this family, dicos-f-02 epoch 90, has NO measured distribution metrics. Its physics quality is unmeasured, not merely unreported.
gaps.closes_when: A diagnostics pod replays epochs 79-114 from the retained checkpoints, or at minimum epoch 90, and the metrics are imported through scripts/refresh_continuation_outputs.py.
